title: MasterChef Tackles National Biomes and Eliminates Contestant
seoTitle: MasterChef Features National Biomes and Elimination
subtitle: Episode features quail preparation and guest chef Bel Coelho
excerpt: MasterChef airs an episode featuring quail preparation and national biomes as its theme, broadcast on Band.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The topic is trending as Band airs the 16th episode of MasterChef Brazil, featuring an elimination challenge focused on national biomes alongside guest chef Bel Coelho. The seven remaining competitors face rigorous, timed challenges in the kitchen.

Preparing the quail

In the first challenge, competitors face the preparation of a quail that must be deboned, stuffed, breaded, and deep-fried, served with sauce and a side dish. They have only an hour and a half to prepare two identical dishes, sparking a rush and tension in the kitchen.

Challenges and tension in the kitchen

The process of deboning and sewing the bird causes panic among the contestants. Only one competitor manages to head up to the mezzanine before the next stage, as judges Erick Jacquin, Helena Rizzo, and Henrique Fogaça closely monitor every step.

Bel Coelho's appearance

In the elimination round, the judges welcome guest chef Bel Coelho, a specialist in Brazilian cuisine and Amazonian research. She shares her expertise on the country's six biomes: Amazon, Caatinga, Cerrado, Atlantic Forest, Pampa, and Pantanal.

Evaluation and elimination

During the one-hour challenge, contestants must use ingredients from three different origins to create a harmonious recipe. The evaluation features rigorous critiques from the guest chef on aspects such as acidity and execution, culminating in the worst performer being punished with elimination.

Where to watch the show

In addition to the broadcast on Band, viewers can watch the show on other platforms. Reruns are also aired on HBO Max and Discovery Home & Health, as well as being available on the official YouTube channel.
